title.ko: 발표 구조 · 신호 표현 · 시각 자료 · 질문 받기
title.en: presentation structure · signposting · visual aids · taking questions

explain.ko: 발표는 서론, 본론, 결론으로 나누고 각 부분을 신호 표현(signposting)으로 연결합니다. 시작은 Today I'm going to talk about …, 순서는 First, … Next, … Finally, …, 전환은 Moving on to …, Let's turn to …, 자료는 As you can see in this chart …, Take a look at …, 마무리는 To sum up, … Thank you for listening. Are there any questions?로 합니다. 짧은 문장, 시선 접촉, 적절한 속도가 중요합니다. 질문에 답하기 어려우면 That's a good question. Let me think about it …처럼 시간을 벌 수 있습니다.
explain.en: Divide a presentation into introduction, body and conclusion and link the parts with signposting. Opening: Today I'm going to talk about …; order: First, … Next, … Finally, …; transitions: Moving on to …, Let's turn to …; visuals: As you can see in this chart …, Take a look at …; closing: To sum up, … Thank you for listening. Are there any questions? Use short sentences, eye contact and a steady pace. If a question is hard, buy time: That's a good question. Let me think about it ….

model_trans.en: Today I'm going to talk about air pollution in cities. First I'll show the current situation, and then we'll look at causes and solutions. As you can see in this chart, pollution has increased over the last ten years. Finally I'll summarise and take questions.
